info.title: Adel Service API
info.description:
Internal HTTP API for Adel Service, the field-service desk for Adel Electric, LLC.
Adel Electric and Service Contracts keep separate books in one database.

Authenticate with a session cookie (`adel_session`) from `POST /api/auth/login`, or with
`Authorization: Bearer adel_…` from an API token. Tokens are scoped to a role
(`admin`, `office`, or `tech`). A technician token can only see visits assigned to that person.

Money is integer cents. Tax rates are basis points (700 = 7%). Webhook bodies are signed
with HMAC-SHA256 over `{timestamp}.{rawBody}` and sent as `X-Adel-Signature: sha256=…`.

The signing secret is returned once. Deliveries include
`X-Adel-Event`, `X-Adel-Delivery`, `X-Adel-Timestamp`, and
`X-Adel-Signature` (`sha256=` HMAC of `{timestamp}.{raw body}`).

Fuzzy-corrects dictionary spellings, then optionally rewrites filler through a configured model.
With no API key, or when SPEECH_CLEANUP=off, the response is the dictionary-corrected transcript (mode passthrough).
The raw speech-engine transcript is returned separately so the field can show the original.

post.description:
Authenticate with a device token that begins with adeldev_. Each point needs a timestamp,
latitude, longitude, accuracy in meters, and battery percent. Points outside the
configured tracking hours are skipped. Points older than the retention window are
not stored. The device must have acknowledged the written notice.
